newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 9.00/9.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 9.00/9.25 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 9.00/9.25 percent on Friday morning, dealers said.
They said early central bank injection of some 1.197 trillion rupiah had flushed the market.
One foreign bank dealer said ample market was anticipated because the central bank had bought dollars on Wednesday to keep it within the intervention band.
Overnight swap was last given at 1.0 points although it will due next Tuesday because of a public holiday in New York on Monday. Spot/next was last at 0.4/0.5 points.
Dealers said operators seemed to anticipate a continued relaxed condition in the money market as reflected by further pressure in the swap markets.
The average overnight interbank rate on Thursday was 9.8 percent, compared with 11.79 percent on Wednesday.
